questions.text: What's something you've changed your mind about in the last few years?
What's a small, ordinary thing that reliably makes your day better?
If you could get really good at one skill overnight, what would you pick — and what would you do first with it?
What did you believe as a kid that turned out to be completely wrong?
Who outside your family shaped who you are more than they probably know?
What's a compliment you received once that you still think about?
What's something you're quietly proud of that rarely comes up?
Which place have you been to that felt most like it was made for you?
What would your ideal ordinary Tuesday look like, ten years from now?
What's a risk you didn't take that you still wonder about?
When do you feel most like yourself?
What's a hill you'd happily die on that most people find trivial?
What's the best piece of advice you've ignored?
What does a really good friendship look like to you?
What's something about you that people often get wrong on first impression?
Is there a moment from the past year you'd like to live again exactly as it was?
What's something you're afraid of that you've never really said out loud?
If you had to teach a class on anything, with no preparation, what would it be?
What's a family tradition, habit or saying you'd want to keep — or drop?
How do you know when you need a break — and what do you actually do about it?
What's a version of your life you sometimes imagine living instead?
What's the most interesting thing you've learned recently, from anywhere?
What do you think we'd still disagree about after a long, honest conversation?
When did you last feel genuinely surprised by someone you thought you knew well?
What's something you want more of in your life right now, and what's in the way?
What's a song, book or film that arrived at exactly the right moment for you?
What's one thing you've forgiven someone for — or are still working on?
What part of your work or daily routine would you never give up, even if you didn't have to do it?
What's something you'd like to ask your younger self, rather than tell them?
What do you think this group, or the two of us, should do together that we haven't yet?
